Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Description: Gluttony Combo is a lalalazy-branded fork of Wrath Combo. Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button - and then some. All upstream credit to Team Wrath / PunishXIV.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.56 (TESTING) - Raidwide shield reliability fix.
- Removed the cast-interrupt for SGE/SCH raidwide shields: cancelling the current cast could leave the shield unable to start ("stops casting but doesn't cast the shield"). The shield is still highest priority and now slots in cleanly on the next GCD instead.

v1.0.4.55 (TESTING) - Healer raidwide upgrades.
- SGE/SCH now cast their AoE shield (Eukrasian Prognosis / Succor) FIRST on a raidwide or stack, then one mitigation - new 10s shield gate separate from the 15s mit gate; auto-rotation cancels an in-progress damage cast so the shield goes out instantly.
- AST: Aspected Helios / Helios Conjunction regen is now timed to land right after the hit and works off Neutral Sect.
- WHM: new 'RaidWide Medica II/III' option times Medica so its regen lands as the hit resolves.
- SGE: new 'Tank Shield Upkeep' option keeps Eukrasian Diagnosis on a tank with >2 enemies and spends Addersting via Toxikon at cap.

v1.0.4.54 - Upstream sync: WrathCombo main 1.0.4.9 tip (3 commits: autorotation override-target handling)
- Merged upstream 06877cca..1c7049c64; all Gluttony fork divergences preserved (15s raidwide-mit gate, Pyretic/Pacification/Silence handling, WHM Divine Caress ground-heal, BLU engine, SMN Aegis Uptime).
- Autorotation: the override target is now cleared automatically when it points at a dead/invalid object, and wiped when autorotation is disabled, instead of being nulled at every early-exit. Fewer stale-target edge cases.
- Autorotation: ability queueing now respects the configured queue window (AnimationLock <= QueueWindow) instead of requiring a zero animation lock, so weaved oGCDs fire more reliably.
- Target: HasBattleTarget() is now null-safe and the override-target getter self-wipes dead targets.

v1.0.4.48 - Upstream sync: WrathCombo main 1.0.4.8 -> 1.0.4.9 (~44 commits, 30 files)
- Merged upstream range 0e6e5a9e..06877cca6 across job rotations, autorotation, and UI; all Gluttony fork divergences preserved.
- MCH: fixed AoE tools firing incorrectly; Reassemble/Hypercharge handling; helper refactors.
- SAM: adopted upstream's completed ST/AoE rotation rebalance (Getsu/Ka + Fugetsu/Fuka refresh guards). Our fork had an earlier incomplete form of the same logic - converged to upstream.
- SGE: AoE simple-heal oGCD spread rebalance; autorotation shield check now optional.
- BLM: fixed level-90 Ice phase. VPR: early-buff opener. WAR: Fell Cleave cleanup. MNK PvP update.
- Added EncounterSafety (Action Penalty Gaze/Motion VFX checks, content-specific fallbacks); p3 invincible status; healer 'Include Shields' setting; DTR updates while hidden; Opener DTR click-to-toggle.
- Fork divergences preserved: UnTargetAndDisableForPenalty plain checkbox + Auto Positionals kept at their location (upstream's relocated duplicate dropped); Pacification/Silence, WHM ground-heal, 15s raidwide gate, HP-scaled raidwide numberOfCasts, SMN Aegis Uptime, manual BLU combos untouched.
- Build clean (0 errors).
